The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.

translations.web: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
translations.bsb: Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.
translations.kjv: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
translations.asv: Clouds and darkness are round about him: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
